nodes.label: CORE_RE Immutable Safety Gate Regex

nodes.label: 10-Foot Leanback Experience Standards

nodes.label: Climin UI Launcher

nodes.label: Debloat Subsystem

nodes.label: Home Guard Invariant Validator

nodes.label: HomeKeyService Remote Key Interceptor

nodes.label: Material 3 Expressive Design System
nodes.rationale: Solid tonal surface containers avoiding expensive frosted blurs; tactile spring physics.

nodes.label: Setupwraith Wi-Fi Drop Protector
nodes.rationale: Protects Google TV provisioning packages holding saved Wi-Fi credentials from being disabled.

nodes.label: TMDB Super Mode
nodes.rationale: Streaming recommendations powered by TMDB API with alternating 16:9 and square card geometry and provider deep links.

nodes.label: Zero-Key Live Weather Hub
nodes.rationale: Open-Meteo REST API integration providing weather and 6-slot hourly forecast without requiring private API keys.
